summary.text: Dalya Attar is a Democratic member of the Maryland Senate for District 41 in Baltimore City and has served since January 24, 2025, after serving in the House of Delegates from 2019 to 2025. Her official page lists her on the Committee on Education, Energy, and the Environment.

paragraphs.text: Attar's official page says she was born in Baltimore and lists a B.A. in criminal justice from the University of Baltimore in 2011 and a J.D. from the University of Maryland Carey School of Law in 2014.
It says she worked as a legal secretary, paralegal and trial attorney at Greenspan, Hitzel & Schrader and has been an Assistant State's Attorney in Baltimore City since 2015.
It lists her as married with two children.
The page says that in the House she served on the Ways and Means Committee from 2021 to 2025 and chaired its Local Revenues Subcommittee from 2024 to 2025.
It also lists her as a member of the Maryland Legislative Jewish Caucus and Women Legislators of Maryland.
